title: LitslSMP
description: LitslSMP is a survival Minecraft server you can play with your friends at litsl.net!
body:
# Join the Litsl Network today!

## What we offer:

### Bedrock and Java Crossplay
Play together with friends on both Bedrock and Java Edition!

### Crystal PVP
Practice and master crystal PvP mechanics in competitive fights created for skill-based combat.

### Kit PVP
Jump straight into battle by choosing from multiple kits and fighting other players in fast-paced PvP arenas.

### Anarchy Survival
Experience survival Minecraft with minimal rules where raiding, griefing, and stealing are all allowed.
